source_evidence: Exact player 'Preconvergence is a long time even for a vampire. Tell me, how long algo did you serve the Silver Court? And speak of this all in past tense. Who/What do you serve now?' asks Ysendre Caul her historical service chronology and present allegiance. Caul says she entered Silver Court service nearly thirteen centuries ago and served decades before Convergence; approximate timeframe newly established in live DM dialogue, consistent with fixed ~1200-year-old Convergence and her actual prior personal service, no exact year, age or duration independently verified. She recalls court halls with ambassadors, scholars and nobles and Sovereign receiving petitions, ordinary firsthand descriptive recollection, not V childhood recognition. She states she is a regent, serves no presently enthroned sovereign, says several former retainers undertook preservation of inheritance pending legitimate successor; reveals in broad terms alliances with other immortals as peers not masters, desire for enduring hereditary order. This bounded self-description follows fixed long-arc-two-antagonists-dm-only.md §§G,I (former sworn courtier, autonomous vampire regent and alliance of immortal peers), not a claim all current peers served the old court, their names/locations or secret organization title disclosed, or proof of present lawful jurisdiction or benevolence. Caul explains she considers present dependents bound by reciprocal protection/service, asserts regency authority rather than accepting V's claim. Asks whether V intends to inherit obligations as well as lands; identity/records still pending. Her claims do not establish moral innocence, oath to V, title transfer, surrender, proven genealogy, father's fate or actual support of other peers. No rolls, movement by V, combat, charm, spending, rest, new record inspection or other resource changes. D334~18:35.
